offering_description.value: Owns and operates visitor attractions and lodging in iconic natural destinations in North America, such as Banff, Jasper, Glacier National Park, Alaska and the Grand Canyon area. Sells experiences, tours, lodging, dining and retail to leisure travelers and tour operators.

primary_services.value: sightseeing attractions and tours; lodging; dining; transportation and excursions

customer_segment.value: B2C: leisure travelers and tourists, including international visitors; B2B: tour operators, travel agents and group travel buyers

end_markets.value: tourism; travel and leisure; hospitality; national park visitation

revenue_model.value: service fees: attraction tickets, tours and lodging stays; product sales: food, beverage and retail merchandise sold at venues

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates attractions, hotels, lodges and tour fleets serving visitors; retailer: gift shops and restaurants at its sites selling to visitors

geography_served.value: North America: Canada (Banff, Jasper, Alberta, British Columbia) and US (Montana, Alaska, Arizona, Colorado)

specialization.value: related lines: attractions, lodging, food and retail, and transportation within destination tourism

distribution_channels.value: online: own websites for booking tickets and lodging; own locations: on-site hotels, attractions, restaurants and gift shops; partners / resellers: travel agents, tour operators and online travel agencies

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: operates under national park concessions and permits (Parks Canada, US National Park Service), plus safety and food rules

notes: Property list may have changed since my knowledge.
